testcase.name: Scenario: Open and close customization while one face is selected: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1866:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and close customization while one face is selected ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part with a solid body is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And one face is selected ✔ And the Tools ribbon tab is selected ✔ When the user opens Customize from the Tools ribbon ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the Ribbon tab ✔ And the command category is All Commands ✔ And the target is Part Tools with an empty custom panel list ✔ And Close is available while Cancel and Apply are disabled ✔ When the user closes customization without making changes ✔ Then the part remains visible ✔ And the selection indicator reports one face
